task_description: Write a method in Dafny which takes a list of integers and only returns the odd ones.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method FilterOddNumbers(nums: seq<int>) returns (odds: seq<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output sequence are odd
- Every element in the output sequence appears in the input sequence
- The order of elements in the output sequence corresponds to their order in the input sequence
